document.id: Pueblo de San Ildefonso Council Res. No. SI-R26-017
document.heading: PUEBLO DE SAN ILDEFONSO COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. SI-R26-017
Act to Request New Mexico Department of Transportation Local Government Road Fund Financial Hardship Match Waiver
document.preamble: At a duly called meeting of the Council of San Ildefonso Pueblo on the 25th day of September, 2026, the following resolution was adopted:

recital.text: the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo") and the New Mexico Department of Transportation ("NMDOT") have entered into a joint and coordinated effort to improve pedestrian and traffic safety on NM 30 at the intersection of Battleship View Road within the Pueblo's lands; and,

NMDOT has proposed a Transportation Project Fund Grant Agreement ("Grant Agreement") for improvements at the above identified intersection and has estimated the total cost of the project will be $1,187,342.24 to be funded in proportional share between the Pueblo and NMDOT; and,
NMDOT's share would be 95% of the total cost or $1,127,975.13; and,
the Pueblo's proportional matching share would be 5% of the total cost or $59,367.11; and,
per the Grant Agreement terms, the Pueblo shall pay all costs which exceed the total amount of $1,187,342.24; and,
NMAC 27.3.8 allows Public Entities who are experiencing financial hardship to request a waiver of all or part of the Public Entity's matching share; and,

the Pueblo de San Ildefonso requests a waiver of the 5% matching funds in the amount of $59,367.11 for the Local Government Road Fund Project for the NM-30 and Battleship View Road intersection improvements.
that the Pueblo de San Ildefonso enacts the "ACT TO REQUEST NEW MEXICO DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION LOCAL GOVERNMENT ROAD FUND FINANCIAL HARDSHIP MATCH WAIVER"

procedural-data.text: The foregoing resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on September 25, 2026, at a meeting with a vote of 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 4 abstaining and 1 absent (Governor presiding and not voting) pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

text.strong: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION TO THE GOVERNOR:

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. SI-R26-017 was presented to the Governor of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso on the

25th day of September, 2026, pursuant to the governing Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Agreement"), GOVERNOR, Sec. 4(c), and will become effective after signature by the Governor or veto override by the Council.

attachment.heading: ACT TO REQUEST NEW MEXICO DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION LOCAL GOVERNMENT ROAD FUND FINANCIAL HARDSHIP MATCH WAIVER

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as the "ACT TO REQUEST NEW MEXICO DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION LOCAL GOVERNMENT ROAD FUND FINANCIAL HARDSHIP MATCH WAIVER " ("Act").

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The purpose of this Act is to request a waiver of all or part of the Pueblo's matching funds for the NM-30 & Battleship intersection improvement project with the New Mexico Department of Transportation due to financial hardship.

section.heading: Findings
section.text: The Council hereby finds and declares that:

para.text: the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo") and the New Mexico Department of Transportation ("NMDOT") have entered into a joint and coordinated effort to improve pedestrian and traffic safety on NM 30 at the intersection of Battleship View Road within the Pueblo's lands; and,

NMDOT has proposed a Transportation Project Fund Agreement ("Grant Agreement") for improvements at the above identified intersection and has estimated the total cost of the project will be $1,187,342.24 to be funded in proportional share between the Pueblo and NMDOT; and,
NMDOT's share would be 95% of the total cost or $1,127,975.13; and,
the Pueblo's proportional matching share would be 5% of the total cost or $59,367.11; and,
per the proposed Grant Agreement terms, the Pueblo shall pay all costs which exceed the total amount of $1,187,342.24; and,
NMAC 27.3.8 allows Public Entities who are experiencing financial hardship to request a waiver of all or part of the Public Entity's matching share.
the Pueblo requests a waiver of the 5% matching funds in the amount of $59,367.11 for the Local Government Road Fund Project for the NN-30 and Battleship View Road intersection improvements.
The Council authorizes the Governor or his designee to take all actions necessary to request a waiver of the 5% project matching costs.
The Governor, or his designee, is authorized to take all actions as necessary to carry out the intent of this Act.
